568:t_1:12.en:
$$アスカ$$
「It's exactly what it looks like.」

568:t_1:16.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Is it because I wished I could do something about this world...)

568:t_2:5.en:
$$レイアム$$
「So you're all going to remain silent about the situation?」

568:t_2:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Silent or not, even I don't know why $c got thrown into this world.」

568:t_2:7.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$, do you have any idea?」

568:t_2:9.en:
$n
「After your EVA lit up in that dimension-like space, we got sent here.」

568:t_2:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Anything will do. If you know something, tell us.」

568:t_2:13.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Anyway, the word is there isn't a single decent building anywhere around here.」

568:t_2:14.en:
$$カトル$$
「If this is the world $$シンジ$$ and the others lived in, I think the best move is to go to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ first and confirm the situation.」

568:t_2:17.en:
$$青山$$
「Then what are we supposed to do?」

568:t_2:18.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Right, $$シンジ$$. Do you know anyone else we can rely on?」

568:t_2:20.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I finally got to meet Big Sis, and now this happens...」

568:t_2:21.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You don't have time to be down, $$ノリコ$$. It's times like this you have to stay calm.」

568:t_2:24.en:
$$カズミ$$
「So you're $$ノノ$$. I've heard most of the story from $$ノリコ$$.」

568:t_2:25.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'm $$オオタ・カズミ$$. I'm the pilot of $$バスターマシン２号$$.」

568:t_2:26.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Another one who rides a $$バスターマシン$$... or rather, you are the $$バスターマシン$$ itself. Will you get along with me?」

568:t_2:28.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Let's work well together from now on. ...May I call you $$ノノ$$?」

568:t_2:30.en:
$$チコ$$
「What's this, $$ノノ$$...? Are you planning to swap out your Big Sis?」

568:t_2:31.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What are you saying, $$チコ$$! $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis is, now and for all eternity...」

568:t_2:33.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't know what happened with the Princess, but hurry up and make up with her, okay?」

568:t_2:34.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't want the Queen of Roses telling us that the $$バスターマシン$$ pilots on this side have no fighting spirit.」

568:t_2:37.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's all right, Big Sis. $$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are the next best duo after you and me.」

568:t_2:38.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The one who concerns me is him, over there.」

568:t_2:40.en:
$$カズミ$$
(Being a wish given form, I can tell... The unbalanced feelings inside him carried us here...)

568:t_2:41.en:
$$レイアム$$
「...I'd like you to cooperate a little more with the questioning. We have to find a way back to our original world at all costs.」

568:t_2:43.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「XO $$レイアム$$. We're told communications to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ won't connect.」

568:t_2:44.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Either some kind of trouble, or they're refusing to respond...」

568:t_2:45.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「The captains are apparently considering heading to Japan to confirm the situation.」

568:t_2:46.en:
$$レイアム$$
「That would probably be the surest way.」

568:t_2:47.en:
$$マリ$$
(Never thought I'd end up going to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ like this...)

568:t_2:48.en:
$$アスカ$$
(Depending on how things go, we might have to pick up where we left off in $$セントラルドグマ$$...)

568:t_2:51.en:
$$カヲル$$
「This return is nothing more than a temporary one. ...Isn't that right, $$シンジ$$?」

568:t_2:53.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The question is whether we can stay safe until then.」

568:t_2:54.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「XO $$レイアム$$! We're told an unidentified group of units is approaching this area!」

568:t_2:55.en:
$$レイアム$$
「All hands, return to your ships!」

568:t_2:58.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$. They're reaching into this world as well.」

568:t_3:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

568:t_3:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...I understand now that you have your own circumstances too. I apologize for treating you like a pampered kid who's never known hardship.」

568:t_3:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...You've completely beaten me. You're far more of an adult than I am.」

568:t_3:9.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Are you saying you'll accept becoming an adult?」

568:t_3:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If you let it get all twisted like $$カシオ$$, it's hard to ever reintegrate into society.」

568:t_3:11.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Not that I'm quoting Captain $$アムロ$$, but I'll aim for an adult's strength in my own way.」

568:t_3:12.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Until I reach $$あがり$$, though, I'll keep fighting as a $$トップレス$$.」

568:t_3:14.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Ha ha... I've finally gotten a pep talk from you.」

568:t_3:15.en:
$$シンジ$$
「S-sorry...! For saying something so presumptuous!」
